string.name: vibrate_reason
string.value: A light tap when you press a key.

string.name: add_keyboard_footer
string.value: Settings, System, Keyboard and input method, then turn Vikey on.

string.name: select_keyboard
string.value: Choose Vikey as the current keyboard

string.name: try_placeholder
string.value: Tap here, pick Vikey, and type

string.name: auto_switch_tip
string.value: Type an English word in Vietnamese mode, or the other way round, and Vikey fixes the word and switches. Press delete right after to undo.

string.name: pause_tip
string.value: After you press VI/EN yourself, Vikey does not switch on its own for 5 seconds.

string.name: web_english_tip
string.value: Web address and email fields start in English.

string.name: telex_style_tip
string.value: Telex and Simple Telex 2: a lone w types ư. Simple Telex 1: a lone w stays w. uw, ow and aw work in all three.

string.name: spelling_tip
string.value: Only add tone marks when the word follows Vietnamese spelling.

string.name: restore_tip
string.value: When a finished word is not Vietnamese, Vikey puts back the keys you typed.

string.name: suggestions_tip
string.value: Show suggested words above the keys. Tap a word to use it.

string.name: autocorrect_tip
string.value: A neighbouring key is fixed when you press space. Delete right after to keep what you typed.

string.name: autocap_tip
string.value: The first letter of a sentence is capitalized.

string.name: haptics_tip
string.value: A light tap on every key. Nothing you type leaves the phone.

string.name: double_space_tip
string.value: Double-tap the space bar to insert a period and a space.

string.name: diagnostics_tip
string.value: The log stores timings only, never the words you type, and stays on this device.

string.name: log_empty
string.value: Nothing yet. Open the Vikey keyboard and type.
